annotations.title: Publish one signed receipt as a Screwtape Verified badge

description: Publish a signed receipt you own so a public page and a Screwtape Verified badge can link to that one verdict. Call it when you want to show that a specific output received a specific verdict. Do NOT call it to certify an agent in general: the page says this output received this verdict at this time, and it is not a general safety certification of the agent. Nothing is public until this call. Inputs: receipt_id (required), include_content (optional boolean, default false; true stores and shows the task and agent output only if that call was retained), label (optional, at most 80 characters), unpublish (optional boolean; true removes the public page). Returns public_url, badge_svg_url, embed_html, and embed_markdown. Requires the API key that owns the receipt. It does not accept x402 payment. Cost: free.

include_content.description: Default false. true copies the retained task and agent output onto the public page.

receipt_id.description: Receipt id from a judge or consensus response this key owns.

unpublish.description: true removes the public page and the badge.

name: publish_receipt
